name: B10-0500/2026 (S&D) – Ukrainian children forcibly deported to Russia or living in Russian-occupied territories in Ukraine
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Ukrainian children forcibly deported or living in Russian-occupied territories in Ukraine
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on Russia to stop deporting Ukrainian children and to return those already taken. It says more than 20,500 children have been deported or moved to occupied areas, and only about 2,100 have come back. It asks Russia to say where the children are, let aid groups reach them, and stop erasing their Ukrainian identity. It also asks the European Union to help Ukraine find and bring the children home.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament is stating demands and opinions, not passing a law.
- **Who it affects:** Ukrainian children deported to Russia or in occupied areas, and their families.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to EU leaders and Ukraine. Russia is pressed to return the children.
